featured_reviews.name: Raghu Ganapathy Achari
featured_reviews.review_text: The Madras Parotta was top-notch! Super soft, flaky, and full of authentic South Indian flavor. It paired really well with the gravy and felt freshly made. Totally worth it—will definitely come back for this again.

featured_reviews.name: Santosh Amin
featured_reviews.review_text: Great Food, super cool ambitious owners. Has that authentic Tamil Nadu taste. 100% Worth a try because we don't get such delicacy everywhere. Traditionally made. And also for health conscious people they have the option of Wheat Parota too... Must try Chicken Kothu Parota and Chicken Kizhi Parota.

Tamil la sollanumna vera level

featured_reviews.name: Yash Kharbe
featured_reviews.review_text:
Madras Parotha definitely impressed me with its authentic South Indian flavors. I tried the nool parotha with chicken curry, and it was absolutely delicious — soft, well-layered, and paired perfectly with the rich, flavorful curry. For starters, the chicken 65 was crispy and spicy just the way it should be, while the chicken sukha had a nice dry masala coating that tasted amazing.
I also had the Kerala parotha with chicken curry, and it was equally satisfying — flaky, buttery, and fresh. Overall, the food quality and taste were really good, and the variety makes it worth visiting.
Giving it 4 stars because while the food was great, there’s still a little room for improvement in consistency or service. But definitely a place I’d come back to!

featured_reviews.name: Rahul Patra
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a good experience at Madras Parota. The parathas were fresh, soft, and full of flavor without being too oily. Portions were satisfying and the prices felt reasonable. Service was quick, and the food tasted homely and comforting. A nice place for a simple, filling meal when you’re craving South Indian style food.

featured_reviews.name: syed yusuf
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely loved the Tamil Nadu–style food here! The parotta with chicken salna was soft, flaky, and full of authentic flavor. The kulambu kalaki was a real highlight—rich, spicy gravy with perfectly cooked eggs, true comfort food.

The chicken Chettinad chukka was spicy, well-roasted, and packed with bold masalas. Both the chicken killi parotta and chicken kothu parotta were fresh, flavorful, and felt just like classic South Indian street food. Even the dosa was crisp and well-made.

Ending the meal with filter coffee was the perfect touch—strong, aromatic, and very satisfying. Simple place, amazing taste, and real Tamil Nadu vibes. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Shubham Raut
featured_reviews.review_text: Best of the foods are often found in less premium places! This place might not be shiny and glittery but the food is absolutely worth it! Had mutton biriyani, single chicken omelette and parota and everything was super tasty! Mutton biriyani highly recommend!

featured_reviews.name: Rathinavel Dravidar
featured_reviews.review_text: Finally, authentic taste has arrived in Mira Road! It felt great knowing that the long journey to Dharavi is no longer needed. Madras Porata offers really good service with truly authentic flavors. A must-visit place and definitely good to go for South Indian food lovers.

featured_reviews.name: Harry Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Hidden Gem for Chinese Street Food Lovers!

Absolutely blown away by the flavors at this Chinese street food spot! Every bite was packed with authentic spices and bold taste — just like the street stalls in Beijing or Shanghai. The noodles were freshly tossed with smoky wok hei, the momos were juicy and bursting with filling, and the chili oil? Next-level!

The service was fast, and the food came out piping hot. It’s casual, no-frills, and exactly what street food should be — quick, flavorful, and affordable. If you’re craving real Chinese flavors without the fancy setup, this place is a must-try. I’m already planning my next visit

featured_reviews.review_text: One of the nest sandwich center's . Its a small makeshift restaurant on wheels which serves amazing sandwich @ reasonable prices. featured_reviews.name: ranganathan iyer
featured_reviews.review_text:
I would say as best sandwich joint around, since my childhood I'm having toast sandwiches here. Peculiar taste we would not find anywhere.
Very famous place in bhayander east, very close to railway station.
Kumar uncle starts by 5.30 PM in evening till around 10.30 PM max as per availability.
The moment he steps in we could see crowd piling up, people order in bulk like 8-10 toast sandwich & normal sandwich which increases waiting time for others.
His speed is ultimate, the way he prepares is awesome.
Attracts lot of trendy crowd, sometimes people step out due to huge waiting time, but he is not bothered by that.
Be it toast sandwich, green chutney, red chutney & tomato ketchup it's all amazing & mouth watering.
Such taste & quality I haven't found such place till date. One would surely enjoy it.

I would personally recommend everyone to try once, will be flattered for sure.

featured_reviews.review_text: Chaurasia has been our go to place since the past 25 years. He was among the first to use bisleri water for pani puri. I have seen him grow over the period of time and what inspires is that the taste has not changed. From Rs 7 sev puri to inr 80 My visit to Bhayander is not complete without an evening snack from here.

featured_reviews.review_text:
"⭐⭐⭐⭐"

.

.

featured_reviews.name: Praveena Padelkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Authentic Chaat centre in Mira-Bhayander.
It is on the station road. Pricing is really high. 90rs for Ragda pattice and it was really tasty. We also had geela bhel which was for 60rs. Ragda pattice also came with sweet curd which was fresh and good. They were not wearing gloves while preparing the food. Just caps on the head.
No parking available to cars because the shop is on road. You have to park somewhere else.
Also the quantity was great! It was more than enough for 2 people. We didn't have dinner after eating this.
